judge a book by its cover: He looks unfriendly, but you shouldn't judge a book by its cover; he is actually very kind.
他看起來不友善，但你不該以貌取人；他其實非常和善。
judge the distance: It is hard to judge the distance between cars at night, so you should always drive slowly.
晚上很難判斷車與車之間的距離，所以你應該一直開慢一點。
judge a contest: The famous chef was invited to judge a contest for the best beef noodle soup in Taipei.
那位知名主廚受邀擔任台北最佳牛肉麵比賽的評審。
judging from: Judging from the dark clouds in the sky, it is going to rain heavily this afternoon.
從天空中的烏雲看來，今天下午將會下大雨。
judge someone harshly: We should not judge someone harshly before we understand the difficult situation they are in.
在了解別人所處的困境之前，我們不應該嚴厲評斷他們。
juggle work and family: Many working mothers find it hard to juggle work and family, especially when their children are sick.
許多職業婦女發現要兼顧工作與家庭很困難，尤其是在孩子生病的時候。
juggle several tasks: As a manager, Kevin has to juggle several tasks at the same time without making any mistakes.
身為經理，凱文必須同時處理多項任務而不出任何差錯。
juggle the figures: The accountant was fired after he tried to juggle the figures to hide the company's huge losses.
那位會計師試圖動手腳改數字來隱瞞公司的巨額虧損後被開除了。
jump at the chance: If someone offered me a free trip to Japan, I would jump at the chance without thinking twice.
如果有人提供我免費的日本之旅，我會毫不猶豫地欣然抓住機會。
jump to conclusions: Please don't jump to conclusions before you hear both sides of the story from the two students.
在聽完兩位學生雙方的說法之前，請不要妄下結論。
prices jumped: After the typhoon destroyed many farms, vegetable prices jumped by almost fifty percent in one week.
颱風摧毀許多農田後，菜價在一週內飆升了將近百分之五十。
jump the queue: Everyone got angry when a man tried to jump the queue at the busy ticket office.
有個男子試圖在繁忙的售票處插隊，讓大家都很生氣。
jump ship: Several top engineers decided to jump ship and work for a rival company that offered higher pay.
幾位頂尖工程師決定跳槽，去一家提供更高薪水的對手公司工作。
jump the gun: It would be wise not to jump the gun by buying a new phone; the price will drop next month.
不要操之過急去買新手機才是明智的；下個月價格就會下降了。
junk the old car: Since repairing it would cost too much, my father decided to junk the old car and buy a new one.
由於修理費太貴，我爸爸決定報廢舊車，再買一輛新的。
junk the plan: After finding the project would be too expensive, the city decided to junk the plan completely and start over.
市政府發現這個計畫成本太高後，決定完全廢棄計畫並重新開始。
junk food: Eating too much junk food, like potato chips and fried chicken, is bad for your health.
吃太多像洋芋片和炸雞這類的垃圾食物對你的健康有害。
junk mail: Every day my mailbox is full of junk mail, such as ads for pizza shops and new apartments.
我的信箱每天都塞滿垃圾郵件，例如披薩店和新公寓的廣告。
justify the cost: The school must justify the cost of the new swimming pool by showing how many students will benefit from it.
學校必須說明有多少學生會因此受益，來證明新游泳池的費用合理。
justify one's actions: The student tried to justify his actions by saying that everyone else in the class was cheating too.
那名學生試圖為自己的行為辯護，說班上其他人也都在作弊。
the end justifies the means: Some people believe that the end justifies the means, but cheating to win a game is still wrong.
有些人認為為達目的可以不擇手段，但為了贏得比賽而作弊仍然是錯的。
justify a decision: The principal had to justify a decision to cancel the school trip by explaining the safety problems to angry parents.
校長必須向憤怒的家長解釋安全問題，來說明取消校外教學的決定是正當的。
keep a promise: If you cannot keep a promise, you should not make one to your friends in the first place.
如果你無法守信，一開始就不應該對朋友做出承諾。
keep a diary: My teacher suggested that I keep a diary in English to improve my writing skills every day.
我的老師建議我用英文寫日記，每天提升自己的寫作能力。
keep a secret: Can you keep a secret? I'm planning a surprise birthday party for Mom, so don't tell her.
你能守密嗎？我正在為媽媽籌劃一場驚喜生日派對，所以別告訴她。
keep track of: I use an app on my phone to keep track of how much money I spend each month.
我用手機上的一個應用程式來追蹤我每個月花了多少錢。
keep pace with: It is often hard for older workers to keep pace with the fast changes in modern technology.
年長的員工常常很難跟上現代科技的快速變化。
keep one's temper: Even when the customer shouted at her, the waitress managed to keep her temper and stayed polite.
即使顧客對她大吼，那位女服務生仍設法忍住脾氣，保持禮貌。
keep in touch: Although my best friend moved to Canada, we still keep in touch by video calls every week.
雖然我最好的朋友搬到加拿大，我們仍然每週透過視訊電話保持聯絡。
keep an eye on: Could you keep an eye on my bag for a few minutes while I go to buy some coffee?
我去買咖啡的這幾分鐘，你可以幫我盯著我的包包嗎？
